findings.claim: Type 3 selects TtRayCast Query; type 2 selects TtCollision Query. Handler is [ [queue+0x130+(type<<5)] + 8*job[0] ]. Type-3 table pointer offset is 0x190, type-2 is 0x170.
unknown: Relationship of these jobs to the traced synchronous casts

findings.claim: Requested Havok names link through signature-1/self-RVA locator-shaped records to executable-pointer table prefixes. Aligned code stores the ray/linear/character tables. This exceeds a name-only lead, but is not a verified player class or complete ABI.
unknown: Object ownership by player or NPC

findings.claim: Ray wrapper 0x78b1c installs candidate hkpWorldRayCaster table 0x2723bc8 and calls 0x9fd68, with alternate path 0x8e744. Callback 0x9fc24 invokes a filter at virtual +8; subtracts transform +0x30 and rotates two input vectors into receiver+0x30/+0x40; copies input dword+0x24 to receiver+0x50; calls shape virtual+0x48.
findings.inference: Input vectors at +0/+0x10 are ray endpoints, and +0x24 is filter-info-like. Transform operations suggest world-to-local conversion; units/axes and precise filter meaning remain unqualified.

findings.claim: Linear wrapper 0x79820 installs candidate hkpWorldLinearCaster table 0x2723d50 then calls 0xa1be8. Its callback 0xa1b48 excludes its own collidable, invokes filter virtual+8 and selects a pair callback via a 32-stride type table at dispatcher+0x2b0.
findings.inference: r9 input+0 is destination-like: subtract collidable transform translation, store displacement and its XYZ length. The +0x2b0 table is type-pair dispatch, not demonstrated gameplay collision layers. Shape/radius unknown.

findings.claim: Routine 0x986ac references TthkpAabbPhantom::linearCast, computes input vector minus a transform translation and its XYZ length, loops receiver+0x110/count+0x118, applies filter virtual+8 and pair dispatch; native callers are retained.
unknown: Whether phantom belongs to player clearance, camera, NPC or another subsystem

findings.claim: Candidate hkpCharacterProxy initialization at 0xccde8 stores primary table at +0, secondary tables at +0x10/+0x18; 0xcce9c repeats those stores and tears down arrays/references.
findings.inference: Initialization/destruction roles are inferred from stores and cleanup. No player object or navigation entry point is proven.

findings.claim: Candidate hkpGroupCollisionFilter secondary table 0x2d686d8 contains 0x146bc0 and 0x146b60. These callbacks obtain filter-info-like dwords from virtual+0x20 or collidable+0x2c and call 0x146898 after receiver adjustment -0x18.
unknown: 0x146898 has no containing PE unwind entry; not decoded by existing wrapper

limitations: Metadata locator/table structure is an interpretation of exact bytes, not complete ABI recovery. Table slot scanning is capped at eight executable pointers and is not a proof of vtable extent.

Name-reference search covers common RIP-relative LEA and stored absolute pointers; zero direct references to name bytes is not absence of use. Relative dword RTTI records required a separate bounded metadata walk.
All retained linear disassembly windows decode to their ends, but unwind regions do not prove a complete/reachable control-flow graph.
Direct-call candidate search is capped at 64 per target; indirect/tail callers may be missed.
No registration/producer tracing, target execution, runtime object inspection, live inputs, game modification, REA/Ghidra import or new collision engine.
